financials_interim.notes: Abans Finance PLC (AFSL) is a licensed finance company (NBFI) -- single entity, no Group/Company split (the filing presents one set of statements only). Cross-checked shares_in_issue: NAVPS Rs.58.26 = Total Shareholders' Funds 4,293,656,717 / 73,693,171 shares (sum of 20 largest holders 72,737,459 + Others 955,712 = 73,693,171, per note (l)) = 58.26, ties exactly; EPS 138,346,298/73,693,171 = 1.877 rounds to disclosed 1.88. No column-swap issues found. revenue = 'Total Operating Income' (1,015,327,719), the filing's own subtotal = Net Interest Income (918,648,972) + Net Fee & Commission Income (85,888,362) + Net Gain/(Loss) from Trading (3,494,527) + Other Operating Income net (7,295,858). operating_profit = 'Operating Profit before Taxes on Financial Services' (356,364,360), the company's own pre-VATFS subtotal. finance_costs/finance_income left BLANK even though Interest Income (1,358,495,460) and Interest Expense (439,846,488) are disclosed as separate gross lines -- because the filing nets them to an explicit 'Net Interest Income' subtotal before rolling into Total Operating Income (same structure as this session's CDB/AAF entries), so populating finance_costs/finance_income separately would double count against revenue. tax_expense = 'Income Tax Expense' (114,037,959) only; 'Taxes on Financial Services' (103,980,103) is a separate VAT-on-Financial-Services-type levy sitting between operating_profit and profit_before_tax, consistent with the CDB/AAF/LOFC treatment this session. current_assets/current_liabilities/inventory/trade_receivables/trade_payables left blank per NBFI convention -- liquidity-ordered balance sheet, no current/non-current split, and 'Loans and Advances' / 'Lease Rentals Receivable & Stock Out on Hire' are the core lending book, not trade receivables. short_term_borrowings = 'Due to Banks' (535,945,533, a small facility consistent with an overdraft-type short-term bank line). long_term_borrowings = 'Other Borrowed Funds' (3,821,274,841), which includes the Rs.1,338,400,000 senior unsecured redeemable debentures issued 30 April 2026 (5-year tenor per note (d)) plus other longer-dated borrowed funds. 'Due to Customers' (12,524,842,905, deposits) is deliberately EXCLUDED from borrowings -- deposit funding, not debt, per project convention. cash_and_equivalents = Balance Sheet 'Cash and Bank Balances' (1,071,966,043); note the Cash Flow Statement uses a broader definition (period-end cash and cash equivalents of 1,942,613,377, which appears to include short-term placements) -- the narrower BS line is used for consistency with other entries this session. capex = 'Acquisition of Property, Plant and Equipment' (74,204,681) + 'Acquisition of Intangible Assets' (678,895) = 74,883,576. Credit Loss Expense on Financial Assets rose from Rs.99,158,392 (Q1 FY25/26) to Rs.149,382,713 (Q1 FY26/27), +51%, the single largest drag on profit growth this quarter -- flagged as a genuine NPL/impairment driver per instruction. Personnel Costs also rose sharply (+47%, Rs.207.0mn to Rs.303.9mn) and Taxes on Financial Services rose 30% (Rs.80.3mn to Rs.104.0mn), together compressing PBT growth to only 5% despite Net Interest Income growing 37% and Total Operating Income growing 32%. Figures are provisional and subject to audit per the filing's own caveat.
